scope: Bounded local DMG Game Boy cartridge interpreter with actual LR35902 instruction execution, memory-mapped controller/timer and raster observation. Restricted to explicitly supported cartridge/header profiles.

support.cpu: Official LR35902 base and CB instructions; invalid instructions fail explicitly
cartridges: MBC1 banking, up to 2 MiB ROM / 32 KiB SRAM
MBC2 0x05/0x06 with up to 256 KiB ROM, built-in 512 × 4-bit battery/nonbattery RAM, A8-qualified register writes and high-nibble readback
MBC5 without rumble (types 0x19–0x1B), up to 8 MiB ROM / 128 KiB SRAM
support.ppu: Bounded DMG background/window/sprite raster with approximate timing; not cycle-accurate certification
support.input: Eight DMG controls mapped to declared action set

failure: Unsupported mapper/RTC/rumble or invalid MBC2 built-in RAM geometry, invalid RAM/ROM geometry, malformed header/checksum, illegal opcode, cycle/resource overrun and modified state/ROM identity fail explicitly. No proprietary BIOS, keys or game ROMs are bundled.
verification: Source-level interpreter candidate including MBC2; native binaries, original generated ROM e2e training, exact LR35902 hardware timing and focused Python regressions must pass independent execution gates before operational acceptance. Boot ROM, CGB-only, RTC, rumble, audio and cycle-perfect PPU/APU behavior remain unavailable.
